scenarios.title: Verify selecting a brand displays products belonging to that specific brand

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. The shopper is on the Products page.
2. Side navigation displays brands.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Specific brand (e.g., 'Polo') with associated products available.
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Select a specific brand (e.g., 'Polo') from the 'Brands' section in the side navigation.
expected: The page navigates to the 'Polo' brand page.

steps.action: Observe the displayed products.
expected: Only products belonging to the 'Polo' brand are displayed in the product list.

steps.action: Verify the page title or breadcrumbs reflect the selected brand.
expected: The page title or breadcrumbs clearly indicate 'Polo' as the current filter.

scenarios.title: Verify switching from a brand selection to a category selection updates product list

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. The shopper is on the Products page.
2. Product navigation displays categories and brands.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
Brand 'H&M' and sub-category 'Jeans' with relevant products.
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Select a brand (e.g., 'H&M') from the brand navigation.
expected: The product list displays only products from the 'H&M' brand.

steps.action: Now, select a sub-category (e.g., 'Jeans') from the category navigation, without deselecting the brand first.
expected: The product list updates to display only products from the 'Jeans' sub-category, effectively overriding or replacing the brand filter.

steps.action: Verify the page title or breadcrumbs reflect the selected sub-category, not the previous brand.
expected: The page title or breadcrumbs clearly indicate 'Jeans' as the current filter.

scenarios.title: Validate keyboard navigation for categories and brands in side menu

steps.action:
Preconditions:
1. The shopper is on the Products page.
expected: Preconditions are met

steps.action:
Test Setup & Data:
N/A
expected: Required test setup and data are ready for use.

steps.action: Use the Tab key to navigate through interactive elements on the page until focus is on the category navigation section.
expected: Focus moves sequentially to the category links/dropdowns.

steps.action: Use the Enter key or spacebar to expand a category (if collapsible) and then tab through sub-categories.
expected: Categories expand, and focus moves to individual sub-category links.

steps.action: Press Enter on a sub-category link.
expected: The page updates to display products for the selected sub-category.

steps.action: Repeat the process for the brand navigation section.
expected: Focus moves to brand links, and selecting a brand via Enter updates the product list accordingly.
